notes: C-472 distinguishes encryption at rest from accountable media inventory and custody; cryptographic protection does not replace media-management controls.
C-475 measures awareness effectiveness through observable reporting and verification behavior rather than completion rate alone.

C-477 selects parallel DR testing because alternate processing must be demonstrated without deliberately shutting down the primary site; the current ISC2 outline explicitly includes parallel and full-interruption testing under objective 7.12.

C-478 maps acquired SaaS and managed-service risk directly to current ISC2 objective 8.4 and preserves organizational responsibility for data handling, shared responsibility, update/dependency, contractual, portability, and exit risk.
C-479 uses digital signatures for integrity and origin authenticity while explicitly limiting any nonrepudiation claim to trustworthy identity, private-key control, and verification evidence.
C-483 treats material platform, interface, and maintenance changes as lifecycle-assurance triggers even when business function is unchanged.
C-485 limits TPM assurance to protected key operations and measured/attested boot evidence rather than claiming whole-runtime trust.
C-487 derives controls from system security, threat, architecture, availability, safety, vendor, and assurance requirements rather than applying a generic endpoint checklist unchanged.
